reviews.text: Esra does a fantastic job, our Teddy looked like a canine superstar after his session. And Esra is clearly a true dog- lover, too- which makes all the difference. Recommended without reservation!
The lady that runs this place is great with dogs and my yorkie looks fabulous when I collect her and she is calm relaxed and happy ,2 hour treatment for £60
Thank you for your 5* review Betty.🐾  …

This place is fantastic. Esra really takes amazing care of our dog when he's in. He's a large, elderly Labrador, and she always gives him time and care when he visits for his grooming appointments.

He is of an age that he does not go out often, reduced walks etc., but he always clearly loves going for his grooming appointments and it's lovely to be able to give him a treat.

Esra also does what she can to accommodate and get booked in, despite how popular this groomers is. Would highly recommend
Esra was so wonderful with my big goldendoodle. The cut looks great!

We’ve been taking Bobby to London Doggo since he was just a few months old, and Ezra has been amazing from the start. As first-time dog owners, her advice, support, and kindness have meant so much to us.

She takes such great care of Bobby and has created a calm, safe environment where he’s always comfortable. The facilities are excellent, always clean, and clearly designed with the dogs’ comfort in mind.

Bobby always comes back looking beautiful, and it’s clear Ezra genuinely cares about the dogs she works with. We would never think of taking him anywhere else. ❤️

Our cockapoo is an extremely anxious, nervous girl however happily trots into Esra’s salon for her grooms! This is the best she’s ever looked - the face shaping is absolute perfection. Esra takes good care and attention to detail and we can tell our pup is so happy here.

Esra is the kindest dog groomer we have met in London. She is incredibly kind, gentle, and caring with the dogs, and you can tell she truly loves what she does. Her facility is always very clean, warm, and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a trustworthy and professional dog groomer.

Important to add that we’ve been there twice already and will book out next session as soon as possible. ❤️❤️❤️
My dog usually hates the groomers and pulls away from the shop fronts. But he's always happy to trot into the London Doggo.. which says it all!

Esra approaches dog grooming with care and confidence. Her professionalism and knowledge of dog behaviour is outstanding. My dog Riley was allowed to play and roam completely freely. The environment at London Doggo is beautifully calm and peaceful, which matches Esra's lovely demeanour. Riley was instantly relaxed with her. Thanks again Esra! You made it all seem so easy! I couldn't have hoped for a better first experience and I know Riley will look forward to his next visit.

Such a lovely place and amazing service! My dog Ruby gets her nails trimmed here every month and is always done quickly and well despite being quite a difficult dog. The place itself is also really sweet and well decorated for waiting in for her to be done!😊 …

5 star service as always from Esra. Matilda just loves visiting the salon for a pamper session and trim. It’s so difficult to find a great dog groomer that listens to what you want  So happy to have found London Doggo. Matilda looks amazing after each visit and simply smells divine afterwards.
Thanks again Esra. We look forward to seeing you again for our next appointment.
100% recommend this business to anyone looking for a excellent service and calm environment.
Great groomer, my king charles spaniel looks and smells amazing after her groom. Owner is professional & friendly, we'll definitely be back.

No question this is a 5 star grooming! Esra was so attentive, informative and genuinely caring for my dog Luna.
Luna can be a little nervous but Esra put me at ease with her interaction with Luna and attention to detail.
Luna looked fab when I collected her, teeth cleaned, coat gorgeous and super clean ears with tidy cute feet.
Best groom she has ever had! Thank you and next appointment being booked 👍🏻

Beyond happy with how my 20 month old cockapoo looks! Best groom she’s ever had! Looks sensational! Wonderful service from Esra! She is a professional! Thank you! Great service and communication! Will 100% be returning! ✨
A perfect place for my pet, I highly recommend it. My little son Bobby and I were very pleased with the service. Thank you!
Thank you so much for your 5* review, Michelle! I really appreciate your support 🐾  …

Ezra is such a lovely person! My Frenchie can be quite a handful, but she was so patient, understanding, and made us feel really welcome. The shop is spotless and has such a nice atmosphere. She truly went above and beyond — highly recommend! 🐾💖 …

I would definitely recommend. we have found our new local groomer Elstra. The location is brilliant right next door to the doggy shop. We booked our appointment via Instagram, on arrival clean professional and welcoming. The prices are reasonable and your doggy leaves smelling like blueberries. We will be returning and letting all our poodle friends know about this place.

My little pom and I happened to walk past the other week and decided to pop our heads in to enquire about getting him a little pawdicure and were very lucky to find that they had an opening and were able to fit us in right then. The owner was absolutely wonderful with my little fella and not only kept him calm and relaxed but did a great job on his paws whilst also giving me lots of great tips! We can’t wait to visit again 😊
Thank you so much for the 5* review, it really means a lot! 🐾 …

I can’t recommend this place highly enough! My puppy had a wonderful experience getting his nails trimmed — the owner was incredibly gentle and handled him with such care. He also loved exploring the shop and had a great time playing around afterward. I’m really looking forward to enrolling him in daycare here soon. Thank you so much! ☺️
Fantastic groom. Great friendly service and our dog loved it!! Thanks
Great addition to the area, and a very friendly owner. Brought my cockapoo in for a full groom and he came out happy and looking perfect. Will be coming regularly.

First time using Doggo n16, for a wash, brush, and dry.  Collected my lovely clean and smelling pooch, found tgat they had filled his nails and clipped the hair between his paws. Really pleased with the service and price and staff.

Come today for a dog nail clip, ended up going with a full pawdicure 😀 It’s a lovely place, very friendly & welcoming! Obviously really good with my doggo too. We’re definitely be returning! Lovely addition to the area! …
